title: QUIZ - 10
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.learningObjective: Convert a fraction to its decimal equivalent by division
questions.question: Convert \( \frac{9}{20} \) to a decimal.
questions.explanation: Dividing the numerator by the denominator, \(9 \div 20 = 0.45\).
questions.hint: Divide the numerator by the denominator to get the decimal form.

questions.learningObjective: Convert a terminating decimal to a fraction in lowest terms
questions.question: Convert 0.15 to a fraction in lowest terms.
questions.explanation: 0.15 means 0.15 out of 1, written as a fraction over a power of ten and then simplified to \( \frac{3}{20} \).
questions.hint: Write the decimal as a fraction with a denominator of 10, 100, etc., then simplify.

questions.learningObjective: Recognize the repeating decimal equivalent of a fraction
questions.question: Which decimal correctly represents \( \frac{1}{9} \)?
questions.explanation: Dividing 1 by 9 produces a repeating decimal: 0.111...
questions.hint: Some fractions convert to repeating, not terminating, decimals.
